questions.title: Make B Equal A by Moving Ends
questions.question: Arrays A and B are permutations of each other. In one operation, remove any element of B and put it at the front or back. Find the minimum operations to make B equal A.

questions.title: Minimum Stabs to Kill the King
questions.question: King has health N. Each stab either reduces health by 1 or, if h = h1*h2 with h1 >= h2 > 1, sets health to h1. Find the minimum stabs to reach 0.

questions.title: Equal Colour Balls on a Tree Path
questions.question: Tree nodes are Red, Green or Blue. Moving takes 1s and waiting 1s at a node collects a ball of its colour. Find the minimum time from S to D ending with equal, non-zero counts of each colour.

questions.title: Add and XOR-All Queries
questions.question: Start with an empty array and process q queries: 'Add x' appends x, 'Xor x' XORs every element with x. Output the final array in O(q). Follow-up: also support 'Min' of all elements in O(q) overall.

questions.title: Scramble String
questions.question: Decide whether one string is a scrambled version of another; clarify the statement yourself, then code and run it.

questions.title: Design a Text Editor Interface
questions.question: Implement insert(offset, text), delete(offset, length) and getContents() with a suitable data structure, judged on complexity and OO design, under strict time.

questions.title: Key Sum Management on a Tree
questions.question: Maintain a key tree under operations: add a new child key to a parent, or add z to every key at level l and all of their descendants. Report final values (winter intern OA, Sept 2024).

questions.title: Count Faster Subordinates
questions.question: In a company tree, each employee has a typing speed. For every employee, count direct or indirect reports with a higher typing speed.

questions.title: Shortest Paths in a Divisor Graph
questions.question: Nodes are the divisors of D; x and y are connected if x/y is prime, with weight equal to divisors of x that are not divisors of y. For each query (u, v) count distinct shortest paths.

questions.title: Minimum Diameter After Removing Leaves
questions.question: You may delete up to k leaves (one at a time). What is the minimum possible diameter of the tree?

questions.title: Distinct Arrangements After One Reversal
questions.question: Count the distinct arrangements obtainable by reversing at most one subarray of a line of N balls.

questions.title: Showroom Subsets Covering All Car Types
questions.question: Each of n showrooms has a set of car types (k <= 15). Count subsets of showrooms that together contain all k types, mod 1e9+7.

questions.title: Find Redundant Servers
questions.question: Server i runs during [l_i, r_i]. A server is redundant if removing it does not reduce the number of integer moments covered by at least one server. Print all redundant servers.

questions.title: Max Non-Compromising Modules
questions.question: Each module has capacity S and exposure E (S > E); a module compromises any module with S <= its E. Select the maximum number of modules so that none compromises another.

questions.title: Maximum AB and BC Swap Operations
questions.question: A string of A, B and C allows AB -> BA and BC -> CB on adjacent pairs. Find the maximum number of operations that can be performed.

questions.title: Downward Paths with Square Product
questions.question: In a rooted tree of up to 1e6 nodes with values 1..100, count ancestor-to-descendant paths whose product is a perfect square (prime-parity masks).

questions.title: Count Arrays Under Prefix AND, Suffix OR
questions.question: You may AND any prefix with a K-bit mask or OR any suffix with a mask, any number of times. Count the distinct arrays reachable, mod 998244353.

questions.title: Min Swaps to Make Binary String Palindrome
questions.question: Find the minimum number of swaps of any two characters needed to make a binary string a palindrome, or -1.
